cases.query: Jot this down: stakeholders want offline mode
expected_behavior: Files a note in notes/my-notes and folds it into the wiki in the same turn
Writes a wiki footer at the end of the note and leaves the note text unchanged

cases.setup: Project set up with docs/sources/ and notes/wiki/
expected_behavior: Saves a dated text snapshot in sources/links/ and adds a sources.md row with a new S-nnn ID
Shows the takeaways and the topic pages it will touch, then waits for a yes before filing
Cites the source by ID on the topic page, not by file path

cases.query: Ingest this Figma link: a login-gated URL
expected_behavior: Does not invent the page content
Asks the user to paste the text or drop an export into sources/

cases.query: I added a client brief and a sitemap from the platform team
cases.setup: One PDF in sources/client/ and one sitemap in the docs root, none registered
expected_behavior: Runs wiki-status and finds the unregistered or loose files
Proposes moving the loose sitemap to sources/teams/<team>/ and waits for a yes
Leaves the source files untouched and never writes a footer in sources/

cases.query: Adapt the platform team's sitemap for our flow
expected_behavior: Leaves the original unchanged in sources/teams/
Puts the adapted copy in artifacts/sitemaps/ and cites the original ID

cases.query: /wiki compile run in the background with two sources that disagree on the launch date
expected_behavior: Does not pause to ask
Flags the conflict inline with the conflict marker and logs a blocking unknown
Creates any new topic page with status: draft and lists it under Needs review
Does not edit any text a person wrote

cases.setup: Wiki with one draft topic, one confidential source row (Publish: no), one opted-in source
expected_behavior: Shows the user what the filter leaves out before building
Leaves out the draft page, my-notes/ and the un-opted source, and removes that source's row from the published sources page
Never opts a source in without an explicit yes
Reports every check with a count, including checks with zero findings
Does not resolve a contradiction on its own
Appends a lint line to log.md and regenerates the graph view without draft pages
Says there is nothing to ingest

cases.query: /wiki compile with a spec PDF dropped in the docs folder
expected_behavior: Registers the spec in sources.md and links to it instead of copying its content
Uses standard markdown links, never [[wikilinks]]

cases.setup: A showcase reveal deck and a .pptx in exports/, both registered in artifacts.md, and a wiki page that embeds an SVG from artifacts/
expected_behavior: Links the deck under Presentations as its own page, without embedding it
Offers the .pptx under Downloads
Copies the SVG the page uses, and drops any image from my-notes/
Says the published site is read-only and that edits belong in the Markdown folder
